title: Bridge to Terabithia
description: A preteen's life is changed after befriending the new girl at school.
note:
One of my favourite childhood movies. This movie made me fkn cry for weeks lmao. It's basically a tragedy that even Shakespeare would've looked at and have gone, "Damn." I had the biggest crush on Leslie when I was young, and um... spoiler alert 🫠. The ending, where Jesse brings May to Terabithia and she makes him the king while becoming the queen herself, is one of the most beautiful scenes I've ever watched. 

I wouldn't even dare watch it again because of the trauma, though. But I'd 100% recommend it to a friend who hasn't seen it yet. If I suffered, they're suffering with me. 😭
